A single N suffices to refute that claim; it does not separately assert nonrepresentation for every N. At N=3 the off-diagonal entry for dyads {0,1} and {1,2} is 1 in the shared-unit covariance and 0 for every two-role parameter triple, including every nonnegative one. Thus the refutation uses the actual covariance families, not a dimension or integrability artifact.
